description: Visual novel translation tool with HOOK, OCR, speech synthesis and many translation engines
notes: Ships the x64 build for Windows 10 and 11. Upstream also offers LunaTranslator_x64_win7.zip for Windows 7 and LunaTranslator_x86_winxp.zip for Windows XP, which this manifest does not track.
Settings, translation records and caches stay in ~/scoop/persist/lunatranslator, so they survive upgrades.
The official extras bucket also ships lunatranslator but is behind; install this one explicitly with 'scoop install scoop-bucket/lunatranslator'.
